instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ahmed Shakir Abd Al-Rida
subject: 03_Data_Mining

questions.question: What may an organization do with customer data?
questions.question_ar: ما الذي قد تفعله المنظمة ببيانات العملاء؟
options: delete it within one working day
publish it on its own website
encrypt it for all the users
options_en: delete it within one working day
publish it on its own website
encrypt it for all the users
questions.explanation: A listed risk is that the organization may sell useful customer data to other organizations.
questions.explanation_ar: من المخاطر أن تبيع المنظمة بيانات العملاء المفيدة لمنظمات أخرى.

questions.question: Which company is named as an example of selling purchase data?
questions.question_ar: أي شركة ذُكرت مثالاً على بيع بيانات الشراء؟
questions.explanation: American Express was reported to have sold customers' credit card purchase records.
questions.explanation_ar: ذُكر أن أمريكان إكسبريس باعت سجلات مشتريات بطاقات عملائها.

questions.question: What is difficult about many analytics packages?
questions.question_ar: ما الصعب في كثير من حزم التحليلات؟
options: they are free to use here
options_en: they are free to use here
questions.explanation: Many analytics packages are difficult to operate, which limits who can use them.
questions.explanation_ar: كثير من حزم التحليلات صعبة التشغيل، وهذا يحدد من يستطيع استخدامها.

questions.question: What does operating analytics software require?
questions.question_ar: ما الذي يتطلبه تشغيل برمجيات التحليلات؟
questions.explanation: Working with these packages needs advanced training, not casual use.
questions.explanation_ar: العمل بهذه الحزم يحتاج تدريباً متقدماً لا استخداماً عابراً.

questions.question: Why do data mining instruments behave differently?
questions.question_ar: لماذا تتصرف أدوات تنقيب البيانات بشكل مختلف؟
questions.explanation: Each instrument is built on different algorithms, so the same task gives different results.
questions.explanation_ar: كل أداة مبنية على خوارزميات مختلفة، فالمهمة نفسها تعطي نتائج مختلفة.

questions.question: What may imprecise data mining techniques cause?
questions.question_ar: إلى ماذا قد تؤدي تقنيات التنقيب غير الدقيقة؟
questions.explanation: When the techniques are not precise, the consequences for the organization can be severe.
questions.explanation_ar: عندما لا تكون التقنيات دقيقة فقد تكون النتائج على المنظمة خطيرة.

questions.question: What follows from tools behaving differently?
questions.question_ar: ما الذي ينتج عن اختلاف سلوك الأدوات؟
options: running any tool is instant here
learning any tool is banned here
choosing the right tool is hard
buying any tool is always free
options_en: running any tool is instant here
learning any tool is banned here
choosing the right tool is hard
buying any tool is always free
questions.explanation: Because the tools differ, selecting the right one for the task becomes a real challenge.
questions.explanation_ar: لأن الأدوات تختلف يصبح اختيار المناسبة للمهمة تحدياً حقيقياً.
